summary: Eight metres of roundabout kerb; nowhere to stop a van.

drivers.seclusion: Bush around the roundabout and houses 30 m or more away, but there is nowhere to stand.
drivers.access_and_room: The line is on the roundabout's outer edge; no verge or pull-off, so a van would block the lane.
drivers.traffic: Roundabout beside an arterial road to the south-east.
drivers.convention: No parked cars and no signs.

sun_shade: Open to sun; tree canopy shades the west and north-east.
